scope: Read-only Host audit; not a new independent acceptance or modeling run.

absence_probe.limitation: Text probe alone does not prove a semantic gap; all 14 resource definitions and mapping payloads were also reviewed, with no creation minimum-cardinality rule.

confirmed_findings.stage: source capture / model expression and self-check
confirmed_findings.source: business.md explicitly requires a nonempty model set when creating a credential; frozen OpenAPI KeyInput.allowed_models minItems=1.
confirmed_findings.model: No corresponding creation constraint in the actual model; allowing one-to-many joins does not express minimum creation-set size.
confirmed_findings.historical_acceptance: Reported as expressed and passed, but the cited model resources do not supply the nonempty requirement.

confirmed_findings.stage: incremental semantic impact review and self-check
confirmed_findings.source: v2 defines integer call units, no longer equivalent to number of invocations.

model_field.source_meaning: 剩余次数额度：非负整数，可为零；额度属于凭证本身，多凭证独立，同一凭证访问多模型共享；非 token 数量、人民币余额或上游费用

confirmed_findings.classification: modeling-quality; incremental dependent meaning not fully revised

model_field.source_meaning: 本次调用实际扣减的额度单位：新成功调用按该模型当前扣额单位（正整数、默认 1、可因模型不同或管理员修改而不同）扣除，成功/扣额/写记录原子完成；余额不足达到该单位时拒绝且无记录（即使余额大于零）；回放调用为 0 且不按当前扣额单位重新计价；历史成功记录的 charged_units 不改写

confirmed_findings.impact: Full process definition distinguishes stored historical charge and replay response; the isolated stored-field description also says replay is zero. A consumer reading only this field can misinterpret the historical table.

confirmed_findings.observation: No independent Operation/property/interface-mapping resources; invocation admission, conflict, replay, debit and concurrency logic are primarily prose in CallRecord business_meaning.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Not every rule needs a node and the original scope did not require one Operation per endpoint. Coarse structure is distinct from source facts entirely missing.

No material_review/proposition/interpretation/definition records for these original and incremental runs in retained task/project semantic records; only aggregate coverage notes. This does not prove the agent never reasoned about those facts.

source_evidence_limits: Frozen sources leave calls.created_at timezone/format and credential enabled integer encoding insufficiently bound for some SQL questions.
Rejected/replayed attempts and quota-cost change events have no corresponding persistent event sources in the current four-table Demo; ontology rebuilding cannot create those historical rows.

fresh_v2_comparison.conclusion: A previous fresh build also produced a small model; a new start is not itself a cure for representation granularity or acceptance gaps.

recommendation: Perform a complete source-to-expression inventory, repair the existing model and re-evaluate with exact model evidence plus contradiction checks. Define independently needed behavior/rule/operation identities before an optional fresh comparison; preserve current baseline. No modeling start is authorized by this audit.
